how_to_change: The source owner approves a new or changed label by merging a pull request that edits this file, then regenerates etl/03_silver (docs/operations/silver.md). A label that is not listed here fails the Silver gate (labels_mapped_*); it is never accepted silently.

identifier.note: Kept as text (fixed six digits). Validated exactly as published, without trimming.

count_columns.note: Every publisher column ending in _male or _female is a learner count, typed INT. A blank stays NULL, never 0. A value that is not 1 to 9 digits, or is above plausible_max, quarantines the row. Counts are not trimmed: a value with surrounding whitespace (e.g. ' 5') is not a whole number and quarantines the row as count_uncastable. No profiled value has it.
count_columns.plausible_max_evidence: Of 9,260,590 published cells (current batches, SY 2023-24 to 2025-26), the largest is 4,097; 10 exceed 2,000 and none exceed 5,000 (p99.99 = 1,059). SY 2020-21 adds 3,535,506 cells: the largest is 2,228, 8 exceed 2,000. 10,000 leaves 2.4 times headroom and catches a count with an extra digit, which no year has.

Modified Curricular Offering Classificat.reason: The only publisher column that is not snake_case (SY 2025-26 only, undocumented by DepEd). The new name keeps every word of the published one.

character_repairs.evidence: UTF-8 bytes of Ñ read as Windows-1252. Bronze, current batches: in barangay 265 / 260 / 261 / 263 rows and street_address 2 / 2 / 2 / 1 rows (SY 2020-21 / 2023-24 / 2024-25 / 2025-26), in every year including the Windows-1252 file, so it is in the published data. Never a legitimate sequence in a Philippine place name.

The same error for lowercase ñ. In school_name 15 / 11 / 11 / 10 rows and street_address 6 / 4 / 4 / 3 rows (SY 2020-21 / 2023-24 / 2024-25 / 2025-26; e.g. 'NiÃ±o', 'DoÃ±a'); these are the school names the profile counts under O-17.

street_address.evidence: SY 2025-26 has no blank street_address but '-' 2,234, 'n/a' 685, 'N/A' 636, where SY 2023-24 has 5,203 blanks and SY 2020-21 5,782 blanks and none of the three placeholders. Matched exactly after whitespace normalization. Other candidates (none, not applicable, NA) are an open question in docs/operations/silver.md.

barangay.note: A published barangay of exactly 40 characters may be cut off (25 / 24 / 25 / 25 rows in SY 2020-21 / 2023-24 / 2024-25 / 2025-26, 13 distinct names per year). Flagged, never repaired.

booleans.evidence: True/False in SY 2020-21, 2023-24, and 2024-25, Yes/No in SY 2025-26. Of the schools in both SY 2024-25 and 2025-26, offers_es True became Yes for 48,819 and False became No for 10,754; 80 schools changed offering, as schools can.

overseas.note: Any marker makes is_overseas TRUE. All three agree on 33 / 33 / 35 / 36 rows (SY 2020-21 / 2023-24 / 2024-25 / 2025-26). In SY 2025-26 these schools are published in CITY OF PASIG, 'Lone District', so Gold must use is_overseas, not place names.

region.rule: Kept as published; region comparability across years (NIR from SY 2024-25) is an Integration and Gold concern (D-012).

labels.evidence: Philippine Schools Overseas, all four years (O-13).

legislative_district.rule: Kept as published. 'PSO' marks an overseas school in SY 2020-21, 2023-24, and 2024-25; in SY 2025-26 those schools say 'Lone District'.

labels.evidence: SY 2024-25 (6) and 2025-26 (7): the BARMM Special Geographic Area, province '(SGA - North Cotabato)'.

sector.rule: Standard set is DepEd's README list: Public, Private, SUC/LUC, PSO.

labels.evidence: SY 2025-26 only. All 171 schools labelled SUC/LUC in SY 2024-25 and present in SY 2025-26 are SUCsLUCs.

school_management.rule: Standard set is the SY 2020-21, 2023-24, and 2024-25 labels (three of four years; DepEd's README matches no year exactly, O-9). Trailing spaces are removed before mapping. 'Local Government' (SY 2020-21 only) is kept as its own value, not merged into DepEd or LUC.

modified_curricular_offering_classificat.rule: Undocumented by DepEd; kept as published. Each label matches exactly one combination of offers_es, offers_jhs, offers_shs (data dictionary). NULL in SY 2020-21, 2023-24, and 2024-25 means the column was not published (schema v1).
